notes:
Sales/POC summary:
- Background: Winterfield Labs (mid-market B2B SaaS - product analytics + in-app assistants). Decided to try Redwood Hosted API first to validate latencies and token economics before committing to Dedicated.
- Hosted trial (2026-02-15 -> 2026-03-05): ran two flows in prod-beta: (1) in-app assistant chat (context window 2-6k tokens) and (2) semantic search for docs (embeddings + reranking). POC team: Sarah (PM), Luis (infra eng), Priya (security).
- Trial metrics (from hosted call logs / sampling):
  * Avg QPS (observed during business hours): 3.1 QPS sustained
  * Peak QPS (spikes during product demo): 24.7 QPS for ~2 minutes
  * Typical concurrency: 6-9 active streams (chat sessions); API concurrency limit hit once during demo (rate limit 120/min).
  * Token mix (sampled requests): short <50 tokens 22%, medium 50-500 tokens 58%, long >500 tokens 20%
  * Avg tokens per request (weighted): ~420 tokens/request
  * Token/sec load at 20 QPS target: ~8,400 tokens/sec (business case baseline)
  * Latency targets: goal <=200ms 1-token latency for short requests; P95 under test was ~320ms on Hosted (some variance on long-context calls).
- POC outcomes / ask for Dedicated sizing:
  * Customer request: baseline Dedicated pool to comfortably handle 20 QPS sustained with 25% headroom for bursts (25 QPS), P95 latency target <=250ms for medium/short requests.
  * Redwood sizing recommendation discussed on 2026-03-03 call: 3 x A100-equivalent GPUs for steady-state (quantized medium model), autoscale policy to add 1-2 GPUs for bursts, KV cache enabled for hot prefixes to reduce token load by ~18%.
  * Forecast note: with planned product growth (feature rollout in Q3), expected 3x increase in QPS over 6 months; suggested capacity plan: start Dedicated with 3 GPUs + autoscale to 5 and re-evaluate after 90 days.
- Cost/pricing conversations:
  * Interested in 12-month reserved capacity with committed throughput discount. Finance asked for line-item showing unit token costs across hosted vs dedicated at target token mix. (Requested doc: drive://winterfield/pricing/Redwood-dedicated-proposal-2026.pdf)
  * Asking about burst buffer pricing and cost for cross-region fallback. AE shared preliminary committed pricing bandning on 2026-03-02.
- Security / compliance progress:
  * Winterfield submitted security questionnaire 2026-02-28; SOC2 attestation requested (we shared SOC2 summary 2026-03-01).
  * KMS integration: they require customer-managed keys (KMS) for Dedicated; engineering asked for sample KMS integration runbook. Ticket SEC-1982 opened for encryption Q&A.
- Technical concerns raised by infra team:
  * Cold-start latency for large contexts (they saw P95 spikes on first-stream after idle). Want warmers / pre-warming guidance.
  * KV cache semantics with session affinity - need docs and recommended cache TTL.
  * Tokenization edge-cases: they hit a PDF OCR output containing adversarial tokens that inflated token counts (~2x); need guidance on token budgeting and mitigation.
